verdict.rationale: Jan publishes its own API Reference for the local OpenAI-compatible server. It documents GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions and POST /v1/messages, each with curl examples and sample responses that a user can run against localhost:1337. However, the reference is static: no try-it console or interactive explorer is documented, and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser try-it console, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Jan's local API server exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API at http://127.0.0.1:1337.
Jan provides a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server that runs entirely on your computer, powered by `llama.cpp`.
The chat completions endpoint would be http://127.0.0.1:1337/v1/chat/completions.
